lamp-low: [draft] The lamp dims for a moment before steadying. There is less oil in it than there was.
lamp-dead: [draft] The lamp gutters and goes out. The dark has been waiting.
dark-warning: [draft] It is pitch dark, and the cave is in no hurry to help you.
dark-death: [draft] You take one step too many in the dark, and the dark does not step aside.
no-hints: [draft] Nothing comes to mind. The cave assumes you know what you are doing.
stalker-death: [draft] The stalker decides the question of who belongs down here, and settles it.
thief-robbery: [draft] Something goes past you at speed. Your pockets are lighter than they were.
roof-fall-death: [draft] The roof finishes what the stull started, and it is not interested in your opinion.
gour-flood-death: [draft] The pool stops arguing and simply takes the room, and you with it.
chute-death: [draft] The chute takes the one more careless thing it has been waiting ninety years for.
swim-death: [draft] The channel takes you the way it has taken everything else that ignored the fish.
jump-death: [draft] The gap was cut for longer legs, and it knew that before you jumped.
keg-death: [draft] The keg goes up before the fuse ever gets the chance to.
